sentences.en: "How did you know I was inside here?"
sentences.zh: 如何做你知道我是里面这里？

sentences.en: "Because you wrote a story about this robot at school," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 因为你写一个故事关于这个机器人在学校， 说 Chip。 ， 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "Well done, Chip," said everyone.
sentences.zh: Chip， 说每个人。

sentences.en: The magic key glowed and the adventure was over.
sentences.zh: 这魔法钥匙光亮和这冒险是在……上方。

sentences.en: Nadim was sorry.
sentences.zh: Nadim 是对不起。

sentences.en: "It was fun being the Master of Storm Castle," he said.
sentences.zh: 它是乐趣正在这有控制权的人的暴风雨城堡， 他说。

sentences.en: "We had to go through the castle and you didn't," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 我们有到去穿过这城堡和你没有， 说 Biff。 ， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "You can put your computer away, and we'll have a game of football."
sentences.zh: 你能放你的电脑离开， 和我们会有一个游戏的足球运动。
